# Historical bootstrap reference

`historical_bootstrap.py` contains the four original generic statistical functions
from `stats_testing/statistical_analysis.py` at commit `befee5c`, verified against
the private read-only historical source archive before copying. Its metadata records
the complete original source file hash. It contains no observations or identifiers.

Keeping this code fixture in the repository lets the exact RNG/effect/interval
equivalence test run from a clean checkout without needing the private archive.
